value.rationale: A complete classification of two-observation deletion effects through the first three nontrivial binary-cube dimensions is a natural finite robustness invariant for Rips complexes. The sharp distance threshold, 32-to-29 three-sphere change, and agreement of topologies under distinct long-distance punctures offer nontrivial motivated benchmark objects for future generalization; not claimed infinite.
